name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - personal/stable
  push:
    branches:
      - personal/stable
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  PYTHONUTF8: "1"

jobs:
  python:
    name: Python
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 40
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact head
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        timeout-minutes: 10
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - name: Verify exact head
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}"

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@d4b2f3b6ecc6e67c4457f6d3e41ec42d3d0fcb86 # v5
        with:
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.14.6"

      - name: Validate environment
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          uv lock --check
          uv sync --locked --group ci

      - name: Run Python checks
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          uv run --locked ruff check . --select E9,F63,F7,F82 --ignore F821,F722
          uv run --locked python - <<'PY'
          import compileall
          from pathlib import Path

          roots = (
              Path("alas.py"),
              Path("gui.py"),
              Path("mcp_server_sse.py"),
              Path("module"),
              Path("dev_tools"),
              Path("tests"),
              Path("tools"),
          )
          failed = False
          for root in roots:
              if not root.exists():
                  continue
              if root.is_file():
                  failed = not compileall.compile_file(root, quiet=1) or failed
              else:
                  failed = not compileall.compile_dir(root, quiet=1) or failed
          if failed:
              raise SystemExit("Python compilation failed.")
          PY
          uv run --locked --group ci python -m pytest -q tests

      - name: Verify generated files and working tree
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          uv run --locked -m dev_tools.button_extract
          uv run --locked -m module.config.config_updater
          git diff --exit-code
          git diff --check
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

      - name: Collect failure diagnostics
        if: failure()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set +e
          artifact_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/azurpilot-ci-python"
          mkdir -p "$artifact_dir"
          {
            echo "commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)"
            echo "uv=$(uv --version 2>&1)"
            echo "python=$(uv run --locked python --version 2>&1)"
            echo
            echo '--- git status --short ---'
            git status --short
            echo
            echo '--- git diff --check ---'
            git diff --check
          } > "${artifact_dir}/diagnostics.txt" 2>&1
          git diff --binary > "${artifact_dir}/working-tree.diff" 2>&1

      - name: Upload failure diagnostics
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: python-diagnostics-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/azurpilot-ci-python
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

  windows:
    name: Windows
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact head
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        timeout-minutes: 10
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - name: Verify exact head
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false

          $gitCommand = Get-Command git -CommandType Application -ErrorAction Stop
          $gitExecutable = $gitCommand.Path
          $expectedHead = '${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}'
          $gitArguments = @(
              'rev-parse'
              'HEAD'
          )
          $actualHead = & $gitExecutable @gitArguments
          $gitExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE

          if ($gitExitCode -ne 0) {
              throw ('git rev-parse failed with exit code {0}.' -f $gitExitCode)
          }

          $actualHeadValue = [string]($actualHead | Select-Object -Last 1)

          if ($actualHeadValue -ne $expectedHead) {
              throw ('Unexpected checkout head: {0}' -f $actualHeadValue)
          }

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@d4b2f3b6ecc6e67c4457f6d3e41ec42d3d0fcb86 # v5
        with:
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.14.6"

      - name: Validate environment
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false

          $uvCommand = Get-Command uv -CommandType Application -ErrorAction Stop
          $uvExecutable = $uvCommand.Path

          $uvArguments = @(
              'lock'
              '--check'
          )
          & $uvExecutable @uvArguments
          $uvLockExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE

          if ($uvLockExitCode -ne 0) {
              throw ('uv lock --check failed with exit code {0}.' -f $uvLockExitCode)
          }

          $uvArguments = @(
              'sync'
              '--locked'
          )
          & $uvExecutable @uvArguments
          $uvSyncExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE

          if ($uvSyncExitCode -ne 0) {
              throw ('uv sync --locked failed with exit code {0}.' -f $uvSyncExitCode)
          }

      - name: Parse and analyze tracked PowerShell
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false

          $gitCommand = Get-Command git -CommandType Application -ErrorAction Stop
          $gitExecutable = $gitCommand.Path
          $gitArguments = @(
              'ls-files'
              '--'
              '*.ps1'
              '*.psm1'
          )
          $powerShellFiles = @(& $gitExecutable @gitArguments)
          $gitExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE

          if ($gitExitCode -ne 0) {
              throw ('git ls-files failed with exit code {0}.' -f $gitExitCode)
          }

          $parseFindings = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

          foreach ($relativePath in $powerShellFiles) {
              $tokens = $null
              $parseErrors = $null
              $scriptPath = Join-Path -Path $PWD -ChildPath $relativePath

              [void][System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile(
                  $scriptPath,
                  [ref]$tokens,
                  [ref]$parseErrors
              )

              foreach ($parseError in $parseErrors) {
                  $parseFindings.Add(
                      ('{0}:{1}: {2}' -f $relativePath, $parseError.Extent.StartLineNumber, $parseError.Message)
                  )
              }
          }

          if ($parseFindings.Count -gt 0) {
              $message = $parseFindings | Out-String
              throw "PowerShell Parser reported findings:`n$message"
          }

          Set-PSRepository -Name PSGallery -InstallationPolicy Trusted
          Install-Module -Name PSScriptAnalyzer -RequiredVersion '1.25.0' -Scope CurrentUser -Force

          $analysisFindings = foreach ($relativePath in $powerShellFiles) {
              $scriptPath = Join-Path -Path $PWD -ChildPath $relativePath
              Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path $scriptPath -Severity Error, Warning
          }

          if ($analysisFindings) {
              $message = $analysisFindings | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String
              throw "PSScriptAnalyzer reported findings:`n$message"
          }

      - name: Run Windows product regressions
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false

          $uvCommand = Get-Command uv -CommandType Application -ErrorAction Stop
          $uvExecutable = $uvCommand.Path
          $gitCommand = Get-Command git -CommandType Application -ErrorAction Stop
          $gitExecutable = $gitCommand.Path

          $uvArguments = @(
              'run'
              '--locked'
              'python'
              '-m'
              'unittest'
              '-v'
              'tests.test_webui_no_reload_recovery'
              'tests.test_device_acceptance'
              'tests.test_powershell_contracts'
              'tests.test_deploy_set'
              'tests.test_webui_deploy_settings'
          )
          & $uvExecutable @uvArguments
          $testExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE

          if ($testExitCode -ne 0) {
              throw ('Windows product regression tests failed with exit code {0}.' -f $testExitCode)
          }

          $gitArguments = @(
              'diff'
              '--check'
          )
          & $gitExecutable @gitArguments
          $gitExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE

          if ($gitExitCode -ne 0) {
              throw ('git diff --check failed with exit code {0}.' -f $gitExitCode)
          }

          $gitArguments = @(
              'status'
              '--porcelain'
          )
          $status = @(& $gitExecutable @gitArguments)
          $gitExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE

          if ($gitExitCode -ne 0) {
              throw ('git status failed with exit code {0}.' -f $gitExitCode)
          }

          if ($status.Count -gt 0) {
              $message = $status | Out-String
              throw "Windows job left the working tree dirty:`n$message"
          }

      - name: Collect failure diagnostics
        if: failure()
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false

          $gitCommand = Get-Command git -CommandType Application -ErrorAction Stop
          $gitExecutable = $gitCommand.Path
          $artifactDirectory = Join-Path -Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP -ChildPath 'azurpilot-ci-windows'
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $artifactDirectory -Force | Out-Null

          $metadataPath = Join-Path -Path $artifactDirectory -ChildPath 'metadata.txt'
          @(
              ('commit={0}' -f '${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}')
              ('pwsh={0}' -f $PSVersionTable.PSVersion)
              ('runner={0}' -f $env:RUNNER_OS)
          ) | Set-Content -LiteralPath $metadataPath -Encoding utf8

          $gitArguments = @(
              'status'
              '--short'
          )
          $statusOutput = @(& $gitExecutable @gitArguments 2>&1)
          $gitExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE

          if ($gitExitCode -ne 0) {
              $statusOutput += ('git status failed with exit code {0}.' -f $gitExitCode)
          }

          $statusPath = Join-Path -Path $artifactDirectory -ChildPath 'status.txt'
          $statusOutput | Set-Content -LiteralPath $statusPath -Encoding utf8

          $gitArguments = @(
              'diff'
              '--binary'
          )
          $diffOutput = @(& $gitExecutable @gitArguments 2>&1)
          $gitExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE

          if ($gitExitCode -ne 0) {
              $diffOutput += ('git diff failed with exit code {0}.' -f $gitExitCode)
          }

          $diffPath = Join-Path -Path $artifactDirectory -ChildPath 'working-tree.diff'
          $diffOutput | Set-Content -LiteralPath $diffPath -Encoding utf8

      - name: Upload failure diagnostics
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: windows-diagnostics-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/azurpilot-ci-windows
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

  security:
    name: Security
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 40
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact head
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        timeout-minutes: 10
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - name: Verify exact head
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}"

      - name: Fetch bounded PR history without historical blobs
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
        shell: bash
        env:
          PR_HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
          PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config remote.origin.promisor true
          git config remote.origin.partialclonefilter blob:none
          git fetch --no-tags --filter=blob:none --deepen=100 origin "$PR_HEAD_REF"
          if ! git cat-file -e "${PR_BASE_SHA}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
            git fetch --no-tags --filter=blob:none --depth=1 origin "$PR_BASE_SHA"
          fi

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@d4b2f3b6ecc6e67c4457f6d3e41ec42d3d0fcb86 # v5
        with:
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.14.6"

      - name: Validate environment
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          uv lock --check
          uv sync --locked --group ci

      - name: Scan source and commit range with Gitleaks
        shell: bash
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          PUSH_BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          version='8.30.1'
          archive="gitleaks_${version}_linux_x64.tar.gz"
          archive_sha256='551f6fc83ea457d62a0d98237cbad105af8d557003051f41f3e7ca7b3f2470eb'
          release_url="https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v${version}/${archive}"
          tool_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/gitleaks"

          mkdir -p "$tool_dir"
          curl --fail --location --silent --show-error --output "${tool_dir}/${archive}" "$release_url"
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$archive_sha256" "${tool_dir}/${archive}" | sha256sum --check --strict
          tar -xzf "${tool_dir}/${archive}" -C "$tool_dir" gitleaks
          gitleaks="${tool_dir}/gitleaks"

          scan_paths=(
            .github
            .codex
            config
            deploy
            dev_tools
            docs
            module
            scripts
            tests
            tools
            AGENTS.md
            README.md
            alas.py
            gui.py
            mcp_server_sse.py
            pyproject.toml
            uv.lock
          )

          for scan_path in "${scan_paths[@]}"; do
            if [[ -e "$scan_path" ]]; then
              "$gitleaks" dir --redact --no-banner --verbose "$scan_path"
            fi
          done

          if [[ "$EVENT_NAME" == 'pull_request' ]]; then
            range_start="$PR_BASE_SHA"
          elif [[ -n "$PUSH_BEFORE_SHA" && "$PUSH_BEFORE_SHA" != '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' ]]; then
            range_start="$PUSH_BEFORE_SHA"
          elif git rev-parse --verify HEAD^ >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            range_start='HEAD^'
          else
            range_start=''
          fi

          if [[ -n "$range_start" ]] && ! git cat-file -e "${range_start}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
            git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "$range_start"
          fi

          if [[ -n "$range_start" ]]; then
            "$gitleaks" git --redact --no-banner --verbose --log-opts="${range_start}..HEAD" .
          else
            "$gitleaks" git --redact --no-banner --verbose --log-opts='HEAD' .
          fi

      - name: Check added files and security regressions
        shell: bash
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          PUSH_BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if [[ "$EVENT_NAME" == 'pull_request' ]]; then
            range_start="$PR_BASE_SHA"
          elif [[ -n "$PUSH_BEFORE_SHA" && "$PUSH_BEFORE_SHA" != '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' ]]; then
            range_start="$PUSH_BEFORE_SHA"
          elif git rev-parse --verify HEAD^ >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            range_start='HEAD^'
          else
            range_start=''
          fi

          if [[ -n "$range_start" ]] && ! git cat-file -e "${range_start}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
            git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "$range_start"
          fi

          if [[ -n "$range_start" ]]; then
            diff_range="${range_start}..HEAD"
          else
            diff_range='HEAD'
          fi

          DIFF_RANGE="$diff_range" uv run --locked python - <<'PY'
          import os
          import subprocess
          from pathlib import PurePosixPath

          output = subprocess.run(
              ["git", "diff", "--name-status", "--diff-filter=AM", os.environ["DIFF_RANGE"]],
              check=True,
              capture_output=True,
              text=True,
          ).stdout

          risky_names = {
              ".env",
              "credentials.json",
              "cookies.json",
              "session.json",
              "id_rsa",
              "id_ed25519",
          }
          risky_suffixes = {
              ".key",
              ".p12",
              ".pfx",
              ".pem",
              ".jks",
              ".keystore",
              ".log",
              ".dump",
              ".bak",
          }

          findings = []
          for line in output.splitlines():
              _, path = line.split("\t", 1)
              pure = PurePosixPath(path)
              lower_name = pure.name.lower()
              if lower_name in risky_names or any(lower_name.endswith(suffix) for suffix in risky_suffixes):
                  findings.append(path)

          if findings:
              raise SystemExit("Risky added files:\n" + "\n".join(findings))
          PY

          uv run --locked python -m unittest -v \
            tests.test_binary_log_audit \
            tests.test_binary_log_audit_arguments \
            tests.test_exception_context_audit \
            tests.test_webui_event_calculator_security \
            tests.test_device_security \
            tests.test_ocr_debug_privacy \
            tests.test_ocr_rpc_security \
            tests.test_ocr_rpc_runtime \
            tests.test_ocr_acceptance \
            tests.test_opsi_zone_ocr_acceptance

      - name: Install pinned browser runner
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          uv run --locked --group ci playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Run WebUI DOM security regression
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          uv run --locked python -m unittest -v tests.test_webui_traceback_security
          mkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/webui-security"
          timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15s 10m \
            uv run --locked python tests/run_webui_traceback_browser.py \
              > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/webui-security/report.json"
          if pgrep -af 'playwright.*chromium|chromium.*playwright' \
            > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/webui-security/processes.txt"; then
            cat "${RUNNER_TEMP}/webui-security/processes.txt"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo 'No orphaned Playwright Chromium processes.' \
            > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/webui-security/processes.txt"

      - name: Verify working tree
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git diff --check
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

      - name: Collect failure diagnostics
        if: failure()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set +e
          artifact_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/azurpilot-ci-security"
          mkdir -p "$artifact_dir"
          {
            echo "commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)"
            echo
            echo '--- git status --short ---'
            git status --short
          } > "${artifact_dir}/diagnostics.txt" 2>&1
          git diff --binary > "${artifact_dir}/working-tree.diff" 2>&1

          if [[ -d "${RUNNER_TEMP}/webui-security" ]]; then
            cp -R "${RUNNER_TEMP}/webui-security" "${artifact_dir}/browser"
          fi

      - name: Upload failure diagnostics
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: security-diagnostics-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/azurpilot-ci-security
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
